answersStore: artifact db, doc checkins/<YYYY-MM-DD> (read with ArtifactData). Fields: caps, themes, notes, newTasks, tasks[{id,choice,mustNotSlip,was}], applied
schedule: Mon 8h, Tue 2h, Wed 9-11, Thu 8h, Fri off. Monday = full week plan; if the week plan is missing, do it on the first run of that week.
nextRunTodo: Read checkins/2026-10-16 from the artifact db. If applied=false, apply it in Todoist (reschedule-tasks for choice dates != was, complete-tasks for choice=done, add-tasks inbox for newTasks), then set applied=true.
Tasks with mustNotSlip=true get priority in the next daily list.
Never delete, archive or bury tasks without explicit permission.
